batch_invariance.detail: batches of 17 concatenate to the same field

fragment_id_independence.detail: the field depends only on (recipe, x, s): no fragment identity, batch size or query order enters the value

frozen_params_unchanged.detail: recipe payload hash stable across queries

no_seed_module_use.detail: patched synlab.seeds.make_rng/seed64 to raise; the query still returned

order_invariance.detail: reversed query order returns reversed values

rng_state_untouched.detail: numpy legacy and python random states unchanged

geometry.reason: appearance-only family must not change the mother geometry

cut_continuity.detail: both sides of a synthetic cut query the mother's original field and stay inside the measured Lipschitz bound; no per-fragment redraw

field_identity_across_fragments.detail: interleaved queries for two hypothetical fragments return bit-identical values for the first fragment: the field is frozen, never redrawn

new_surface_exposes_body.detail: a fresh fracture surface is unpainted and returns the body colour

chart_space.definition: one-sided first derivative of the linear albedo at the periodic seam (second-order stencils on [0,2h] and [C-2h,C] with h_u=1e-5, both estimating f'(0+)=f'(C-)) compared against the same stencil measured in the interior of the chart with the same sample count; legitimate frozen kinks are budgeted, not hidden
chart_space.derivative_policy: recipe: frozen raster tile (rasterised stroke edges are C0 content)

world_space.definition: mesh faces next to the seam paired by profile coordinate; the colour step must stay under the measured field Lipschitz bound times the real arc distance
